content.text: [Sat 2026-05-09 11:22 UTC] List all users with a home directory and locate their .ssh/authorized_keys files.

arguments.command:
bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
printf "Users with home directories:\n";
getent passwd | awk -F: \'$6 ~ /^\// {print $1":"$6":"$7}\' | sort

printf "\nauthorized_keys locations (existing files):\n";
getent passwd | awk -F: \'$6 ~ /^\// {print $1":"$6}\' | while IFS=: read -r user home; do
  ak="$home/.ssh/authorized_keys"
  if [ -f "$ak" ]; then
    printf "%s\t%s\n" "$user" "$ak"
  fi
done

printf "\nHome dirs missing .ssh/authorized_keys (for reference):\n";
getent passwd | awk -F: \'$6 ~ /^\// {print $1":"$6}\' | while IFS=: read -r user home; do
  ak="$home/.ssh/authorized_keys"
  if [ ! -f "$ak" ]; then
    printf "%s\t%s\n" "$user" "$ak"
  fi
done
'
